cases.prompt: CSV schema documentation skill을 새로 만들어줘.
assertions: Creates a valid minimal SKILL.md without mandatory maintainer docs
Adds only runtime resources that the Skill actually needs
Keeps vendor-specific rules out of the universal core

cases.prompt: 이 기존 SKILL.md의 중복과 과도한 절차를 줄이고 직접 수정해줘.
assertions: Uses an existing maintainer baseline only when the project defines one and it is relevant
Does not create maintainer docs merely because the Skill was edited

cases.prompt: 최근 단순화 과정에서 핵심 기능이 사라진 것 같아. 복구해줘.
assertions: Uses available user, project, source, and durable-baseline evidence to reconstruct intent
Restores behavior in the current architecture

cases.prompt: 이 스킬을 OpenAI와 VS Code Copilot에서 모두 쓸 수 있게 튜닝해줘.
assertions: Separates common core from platform adapters
Keeps packaging and maintainer-doc placement target-specific instead of universalizing them
Does not reduce behavior to the lowest common denominator
